title: Multiplication by a monomial shifts Fourier support
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $U,S\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function $x\\mapsto f(x)\\prod_{i\\in U}x_i$ equals $\\widehat f(U\\triangle S)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$U$ and $S$ are subsets of the coordinates
